summary: Sesi #38 / INV-F44 (FIFO batch COGS -> accounting journal) verified independently. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter96_cogs_fifo_journal.py (13 tests, 12 PASS / 1 FAIL revealing a real disclosure gap) exercising post_cogs_on_buyer_dispatch at function level with synthetic material_id + self-cleaning artifacts, plus HTTP regression on buyer-shipment endpoints. Re-ran scripts/verify_cogs_fifo_jurnal.py twice: VERDICT HIJAU (10/10) both before and after my testing. Frontend verified on the public preview URL: module prod-shipments-buyer loads, 'HPP Batch (FIFO)' column present in the expanded Riwayat Dispatch table, em-dash shown for rows without cost layers, and with a temporarily injected fg_cogs the cell + dispatch badge render 'Rp 960.000' with the 'pcs tanpa lapisan biaya' warning (injected data was fully reverted). Zero console errors. DB left byte-identical to the pre-test state (3 shipments / 6 items / 28 layers / 0 fg_cogs fields / 0 buyer_dispatch journals).

minor.issue: A shipment line that leaves the warehouse FULLY uncosted (fg_cogs == 0, fg_cogs_layers == [], fg_cogs_uncosted_qty = 10) is skipped by `if row_total <= 0 and not used: continue` BEFORE `out['uncosted_qty'] += ...`. In a mixed dispatch (1 costed line + 1 fully uncosted line) the journal was posted for Rp 40.000 with basis=fifo_batch, uncosted_qty=0 and note=None — the 10 pcs that left at zero cost are NOT disclosed anywhere, which breaks the same honesty promise gate J6 protects (gate J6 only covers the PARTIALLY covered case). Repro: pytest tests/test_iter96_cogs_fifo_journal.py::TestFifoCogsJournal::test_f_fully_uncosted_line_must_still_be_disclosed. Suggested fix: accumulate `out['uncosted_qty'] += int(r.get('fg_cogs_uncosted_qty') or 0)` (and append a gap note) BEFORE the `continue`.

ui_bugs.issue: `item.fg_cogs == null ? '—' : fmtRp(...)` means a line where fg_cogs is present but 0 (which is exactly what _issue_fg_for_dispatch writes today for every SKU whose cost layers have unit_cost 0 — i.e. almost all demo SKUs) renders 'Rp 0'. That is the invented Rp 0 the backend deliberately refuses to journal. Suggest treating Number(item.fg_cogs) <= 0 as '—' (or 'belum berbiaya').

rca_of_the_issue: In _fifo_cogs_for_dispatch the per-row guard `if row_total <= 0 and not used: continue` runs before `out['uncosted_qty'] += int(r.get('fg_cogs_uncosted_qty') or 0)`. Rows that shipped entirely without cost layers therefore contribute neither cost nor an uncosted count, so post_cogs_on_buyer_dispatch reports uncosted_qty=0 / note=None while the posted COGS silently understates reality. Gate INV-F44/J6 does not catch it because it only tests a partially-covered line (layers used + leftover), where the accumulation is reached.
